# Skill: React Simple Web App

Use this skill when creating or modifying a simple React + JavaScript web application.

## Objectives
1. Generate a minimal React app structure.
2. Build a small feature using reusable components.
3. Add basic state handling and user interaction.
4. Keep implementation straightforward and easy to understand.

## Guidance
- Prefer JavaScript files (`.js`/`.jsx`).
- Keep components focused on one responsibility.
- Include basic error handling and empty states when relevant.
